name: cut
description: Remove sections from each line of files

name: -b
--bytes
options.description: Filter byte columns from the input source

name: -d
--delimiter
options.description: Specify the delimiter character that separates fields in the input source

options.name: -w
options.description: Use any number of whitespace (Space, Tab) to separate fields in the input source

name: -f
--fields
options.description: Filter field columns from the input source

options.name: --complement
options.description: Invert the filter - instead of displaying only the filtered columns, display all

name: -s
--only-delimited
options.description: In field mode, only print lines which contain the delimiter

name: -z
--zero-terminated
options.description: Instead of filtering columns based on line, filter columns based on \\0 (NULL

options.name: --output-delimiter
options.description: In field mode, replace the delimiter in output lines with this option's argument
